name: Outside Accursed Halls
title: Outside Accursed Halls
summary: The twin of Walled Portals, deeper in the Direlands: a small walled court of six flat-roofed halls with stake palisades on a rocky shelf (z 40) in the sedimentary badlands. It holds the Accursed Halls portal and the Walled Portals return portal. Its steps lead from inside to outside, which once made it a levelling spot for young archers and mages.
